ideas.pitch: A manually controlled wired bot featuring an adaptive mechanical linkage and multi-jaw gripper designed to securely grasp irregular shapes and cubes.
ideas.title: Shape-Shift Gripper Bot
ideas.why_it_could_win: Demonstrates precision physical hardware handling and mechanical ingenuity, aligning with the robotics bot design task.

ideas.pitch: An add-on module using an ESP32 camera to stream a live top-down alignment view to a driver screen, ensuring precise insertion of blocks into cubic grooves.
ideas.title: Groove-Finder Vision Assist
ideas.why_it_could_win: Combines mechanical robotics with computer vision feedback, giving the operator an unfair advantage in precision alignment.

ideas.pitch: A wireless robotic vehicle with a dual-frequency transceiver to avoid interference, built for rapid shape sorting and insertion tasks.
ideas.title: Dual-Frequency Quick-Swap Wireless Bot
ideas.why_it_could_win: Directly targets the wireless control and range requirements specified in the challenge description with robust fault tolerance.

ideas.pitch: A custom 3D-printed passive compliance end-effector attached to a manual robot arm that self-aligns blocks into tight grooves without jamming.
ideas.title: Compliant Mechanism Insertion End-Effector
ideas.why_it_could_win: Solves the mechanical tolerance problem elegantly through smart design rather than complex coding, impressing hardware judges.

ideas.pitch: A multi-axis robotic arm with an active cable management spring-spool system that keeps control wires slack and out of the operating arena.
ideas.title: Tension-Managed Wired Robotic Arm
ideas.why_it_could_win: Addresses a common operational failure point in wired robots during tight maneuverability tests.
